platformOnlyTests.rationale: Exercises guarded Windows package-local descriptor publication, atomic replacement, canonical loading, durability, and shutdown removal.
Exercises Windows file-identity checks that prevent failed-publication cleanup from deleting a descriptor replaced after the atomic move.
Exercises identity-guarded cleanup of an endpoint descriptor when validation or durability fails after the atomic move.
Exercises Windows handle-based descriptor deletion and proves a pathname replacement is preserved after the original file is verified.
Exercises Windows reparse-point rejection and file-sharing guards that block descriptor deletion or replacement during a read.
Exercises Windows guarded reads while rejecting truncated, over-limit, and future-schema discovery files before trust.
Queries Windows access-token, integrity, session, process-image, creation-time, and AppModel identity fields used for mutual named-pipe authentication.

Exercises Windows-only SecurityIdentification named-pipe impersonation, access-token and AppModel identity binding, and rejection of a substituted process identity that could otherwise exploit PID reuse.
Exercises Windows-only named-pipe connection orientation so client and server identity accessors cannot silently return the observation for the wrong endpoint.
Exercises retained Windows process-handle liveness after complete frame assembly so buffered requests from exited peers are not admitted.
Exercises the expired-deadline branch used to cancel and drain pending Windows overlapped I/O before releasing its storage.
Exercises the Windows-only fail-stop path required when RevertToSelf cannot restore the agent thread after named-pipe client impersonation.
Exercises the protected session-local single-agent mutex and Windows FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE endpoint-squatting protection across the complete named-pipe listener pool.
Validates the Windows protected pipe DACL contains only LocalSystem and the current logon SID.
Validates Windows local named-pipe endpoint syntax and per-start cryptographic randomization.
Exercises Windows AppModel queries and proves missing MSIX package identity fails the production peer policy.
Connects a same-user unpackaged Windows process and verifies pre-protocol rejection without sacrificing a listener instance.
Exercises Windows file-share locks that prevent vault replacement before SQLite opens the guarded file.
Exercises Windows junction traversal, which is distinct from portable symbolic-link handling.
Exercises Windows file identity and sharing semantics during atomic vault publication.
Exercises Windows metadata revalidation when a linked staging file is mutated during publication.
Exercises Windows share-mode protection for the reserved staging file during vault initialization.
Exercises Windows share-mode protection across password work and unlocked-session publication.
Exercises Unix permission bits, which do not exist under Windows access-control-list semantics.
Exercises Unix inode binding while the reserved staging file is initialized.
Exercises Unix special-file handling without opening potentially blocking FIFO paths.
Exercises Unix hard-link and inode replacement behavior during atomic vault publication.
Exercises Unix inode-bound snapshot reads while the visible vault path is replaced.
Exercises Unix descriptor-based size revalidation immediately before snapshot allocation.
Exercises Unix descriptor and inode binding when a vault ancestor directory is replaced.
Exercises Unix inode replacement during password work and requires unlock to fail closed.
Exercises Unix in-place vault rewriting during password work and requires unlock to fail closed.
